answer: A raven vouches a newcomer once in its life, locking its whole stake in the vault, forfeited if the key is caught false, and a vouched key may itself vouch only after N attested epochs of its own judged work. A vine lengthens by one key per N epochs, strictly serial: k clones cost k×N chained epochs no operator can run in parallel, lend, or split. An honest newcomer takes any unused raven's lock at base. The shortcut is bribing unrelated ravens to spend their single vouch, each bribe covering that raven's entire vault, burned with it when its clone is caught.
